title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 Client Policy and Registry Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, DNS package build, full solution test, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9461 client-policy/operator-guidance surface.
scope: This verification covers dohpath HTTPS RR query suppression, equivalent HTTPS RR publication guidance, high-speed AliasMode avoidance and TargetName convention guidance, secure transport authentication to the selected authentication name, DNS-query client identity suppression with the known-safe exception, invalid-response query suppression and optional logging, SVCB-reliant behavior after successful SVCB resolution, dependent-specification fallback adjustment, cleartext fallback discouragement, dohpath registry key, SVCB RR type, and automatic mandatory-port metadata.
preconditions: The RFC 9461 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9461.json`.
Endpoint selection already produced a `DnsServiceBindingEndpoint` from scalar SVCB record data.
expected_result: The focused client-policy tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9461 artifacts, generated triage reflects the client-policy slice, diff hygiene passes, and the full solution test suite remains green.
status_summary: The RFC 9461 DNS service binding mapping is trace-owned and verified. DNS SVCB wire parsing and operator DNS publication automation remain future adapter work.
